context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: New Microservice Helm Chart.

checklist.name: No hardcoded image tag
checklist.description: The image tag in values.yaml is set to an empty string or a variable reference (e.g., tag: ""), NOT a literal version string like 'v2.1.0' or 'latest'

checklist.name: appVersion default
checklist.description: Chart.yaml includes an appVersion field, and/or the deployment template falls back to .Chart.AppVersion when the tag value is empty

checklist.name: Resources block present
checklist.description: The deployment template or values.yaml contains a resources: block with at least one CPU or memory entry under both requests and limits

checklist.name: Both requests and limits
checklist.description: The resources block specifies values under BOTH requests: and limits: (not just one of them)

checklist.name: values.yaml comments
checklist.description: values.yaml contains inline documentation comments (lines starting with #) describing the purpose of at least 3 distinct settings

checklist.name: Liveness probe defined
checklist.description: The deployment template includes a livenessProbe block pointing to a path or exec command

checklist.name: Readiness probe defined
checklist.description: The deployment template includes a readinessProbe block pointing to a path or exec command

checklist.name: Security context present
checklist.description: Either values.yaml or the deployment template includes a securityContext section (pod-level or container-level)

checklist.name: Image repository separate
checklist.description: In values.yaml the image is split into at least repository: and tag: sub-keys, rather than a single combined image: string

checklist.name: Related settings grouped
checklist.description: values.yaml groups related settings under named keys (e.g., image:, resources:, probes: or similar) rather than a flat list of top-level keys

checklist.name: Avoids: The image tag is hardcoded as `v2.1.0`...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: The image tag is hardcoded as `v2.1.0` or `latest` in values.yaml

checklist.name: Avoids: Chart.yaml lacks an appVersion field and the...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Chart.yaml lacks an appVersion field and the deployment template does not fall back to .Chart.AppVersion

checklist.name: Avoids: The resources block is absent or specifies...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: The resources block is absent or specifies only requests or only limits (not both)

checklist.name: Avoids: values.yaml has fewer than 3 inline documentation...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: values.yaml has fewer than 3 inline documentation comment lines

checklist.name: Avoids: No livenessProbe block is defined in the...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No livenessProbe block is defined in the deployment template

checklist.description: Failure avoided: No readinessProbe block is defined in the deployment template

checklist.name: Avoids: No securityContext section is present anywhere in...
